Attached: 1 image

PasswordPusher v2.13.0 is here. This release completely rebuilds the password generator with three new modes: Passphrase (5 languages), Password (granular control), and PIN. 🔒

Devs get a new `POST /api/v2/generate` endpoint for batch generation. Note: 9 legacy PWP__GEN__* env vars are replaced with structured settings.

Release: https://github.com/pglombardo/PasswordPusher/releases/tag/v2.13.0
Run: https://pikapods.com/pods?run=pwpush

#opensource #selfhosted
